dendrogram.format: [x_left, x_right, h_left, h_right, h_top]; x in leaf index (0 = first unit), h 0-1 (relative merge height)

a.source: fig_4.pdf panel a: column order and dendrogram from the vector dendrogram (ward.D2); the stacked bars are a raster image, decoded per column (exact palette colours, 0.32 percentage-point rows). Columns whose decoded composition matches a unit computed from the per-cell data (8 WT, 15 FTE cores, 95 TMA A patients on their final cores) carry that code and the data-derived composition (src 'data'); TMA B patients keep the decoded composition and no code (src 'raster').

tma.note: TMA points are a raster in the PDF and cannot be read back; the median is the drawn (vector) median line. Per-patient values are given for TMA A only, recomputed from the per-cell data (observed statistic, final cores with >= 500 secretory cells, mean over a patient's cores); TMA B per-cell data are not on this machine.

d.source: fig_4.pdf panel d (WT points vector; codes assigned by matching per-tissue values recomputed from the per-cell data)
